title: Eye mutex force-release recovery
desc: Force-release abandoned Eye mutexes via PowerShell when Eye cannot restart after crash. Mutex names: Global\WKAppBotEyeAlive/Guardian/Spawn. Use Mutex.OpenExisting+ReleaseMutex then wkappbot-core.exe eye to restart.
steps: Force-release abandoned Eye mutexes via PowerShell when Eye cannot restart after crash. Open mutex by name (Global\WKAppBotEyeAlive, Global\WKAppBotEyeGuardian, Global\WKAppBotEyeSpawn) with Mutex.OpenExisting, call ReleaseMutex, then restart via wkappbot-core.exe eye.
author: claude
